english.title: Cause use of a vehicle with obligatory lighting equipment not fitted
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which was not fitted with **(..SPECIFY OBLIGATORY LAMP(S)/REFLECTOR(S)/ REAR MARKING(S)/DEVICE(S)..) of a type specified in regulation 18(1) of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989.
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 18(1)of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
caused use on a road of a vehicle when obligatory lamp(s)/reflector(s)/rear marking(s)/device(s)
of type specified in regulation 18(1) were not fitted

english.notes:
(i) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(ii) See also offence wordings: H3111 and H3113.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) which was not fitted with **(..SPECIFY LAMP(S)/REFLECTOR(S)/REAR MARKING(S)/DEVICE(S)..).

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
